output.summary: Grounded Performance Measurement, Tracking, Experimentation, and Diagnostic Framework designed for PROD_OLLAMA_LOCAL_AI in PLANNING_ONLY mode. Establishes telemetry taxonomy, non-telemetry developer event mapping, experiment specifications PEXP-001 through PEXP-003, allocation logic, and falsifiable diagnostic thresholds while strictly preserving missing baseline telemetry.

measurement_framework.business_objective: Drive qualified developer adoption and local CLI/daemon activation on macOS, Linux, and Windows without cloud token friction.
measurement_framework.campaign_objective: Demand creation and technical documentation/download activation.
primary_kpis: Outbound Download / Documentation Link CTR (Denom: Impressions)
Landing Page Download Initiation Rate (Denom: Landing Page Unique Sessions)
CLI First-Run Activation Proxy (Denom: Verified Downloads, TO_BE_ESTABLISHED via voluntary ping/docs completion)
secondary_kpis: 3-Second Hook Retention Rate (Denom: Total Video Impressions)
Average Documentation Reading Depth (Denom: Documentation Sessions)
Model Sizing Guide Interaction Rate (Denom: Hardware Page Visitors)
guardrail_metrics: Landing Page Bounce Rate (<1s visit anomaly indicating bot traffic/click misdirection)
VRAM Misconfiguration Bounce Rate (drop-off on hardware chart indicating hardware incompatibility)
Non-Configured Stop-Loss Guardrail: Hard stop thresholds remain NOT_CONFIGURED pending explicit CMO budgetary input.

attribution_context.attribution_method: Multi-Touch First-Click / Direct Platform with Geo-Holdout validation planned for scale
key_assumptions: Platform click-through data reflects direct technical interest but not guaranteed successful local CLI execution.
Organic word-of-mouth creates unmeasured baseline lift in direct GitHub/CLI downloads.
known_limitations: Private local execution and lack of telemetry daemon mean post-install usage cannot be directly tracked without client opt-in.
Ad network post-view attribution over-credits generic developer search interest.

taxonomy.trigger: Ad creative loaded in developer feed or search result
User watches >= 3 seconds of technical terminal workflow video
Outbound click to Ollama documentation or platform binary download page
Scroll depth reaches 7B/14B VRAM compatibility table
User clicks direct binary download button for OS
User clicks clipboard copy button for 'curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh'

data_validation_protocol: Deduplicate repeated binary download clicks within a 5-minute window per IP/session.
Reconcile web server log downloads against client-side analytics event dispatches.
Enforce UTM parameter strictness: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content (matching variant IDs VAR-A, VAR-B, VAR-C).

experiments.name: Terminal Setup Hook vs Generic AI Feature Hook
experiments.objective: Test whether friction-focused terminal demonstration (VAR-A, SCRIPT-SF-01) improves link CTR compared to standard feature announcement copy.

variants.hypothesis: Terminal 1-line setup visual break drives higher link CTR among engineers seeking fast local execution.
Standard high-level local AI capability overview.

experiments.sample_size_requirement: TO_BE_ESTABLISHED upon initial traffic baseline stabilization
experiments.decision_rule: If VAR-A Link CTR > VAR-CONTROL with non-overlapping 95% confidence intervals and bounce rate within guardrails, scale VAR-A. If intervals overlap, mark INCONCLUSIVE.

experiments.name: Localhost REST API Specificity vs Abstract Privacy Messaging
experiments.objective: Evaluate whether highlighting localhost:11434 API integration (VAR-B, COPY-SF-02) increases technical documentation page depth.

variants.hypothesis: API endpoint specificity captures developer builder intent and drives deeper documentation exploration.
Broad offline privacy and zero-token cost value proposition.

experiments.primary_metric: Documentation Session Depth (>2 API pages viewed or endpoint copy event)
experiments.decision_rule: If VAR-B documentation depth exceeds control with practical significance, validate API-first messaging for developer builder cohorts.

experiments.name: Upfront VRAM Hardware Sizing vs Direct Immediate Download CTA
experiments.objective: Determine whether transparent 7B/14B VRAM requirements (VAR-C, COPY-SF-03) pre-qualify traffic and reduce misconfiguration drop-offs.

variants.hypothesis: Upfront hardware sizing reduces unqualified downloads on underpowered machines and increases install-command copy rate.
Direct download CTA maximizes raw top-of-funnel binary download initiation.

experiments.primary_metric: Qualified Download Intent Rate (Download Initiation or CLI Copy / Landing Page Sessions)
experiments.decision_rule: Evaluate trade-off between top-of-funnel click volume and qualified post-click installation intent. Mark INCONCLUSIVE if conversion variance is high.

allocation_principles: Phase 1 (Exploration): Split traffic equally (33.3% / 33.3% / 33.3%) across VAR-A, VAR-B, and VAR-C across verified developer channels (GitHub forums, technical search discovery).
Phase 2 (Evaluation): Hold test variants until planned sample power is reached. Do not halt early for small-number anomalies.
Phase 3 (Exploitation): Reallocate proportional distribution towards validated winner only if statistical criteria are met and guardrails respected; if INCONCLUSIVE, maintain balanced learning split.
media_allocation_logic.stop_loss_rules: No artificial stop-loss dollar amount is assumed. Stop-loss logic requires explicit campaign budgetary ceilings from CMO.

diagnostic_matrix.symptom: High impressions, low CTR on VAR-A
diagnostic_matrix.investigation: Deconstruct opening 2-second terminal visual; evaluate whether font sizing or terminal contrast fails to communicate ease of use.

diagnostic_matrix.symptom: High CTR, low documentation depth on VAR-B
diagnostic_matrix.investigation: Check whether ad promised immediate curl API syntax while landing page directed to generic download overview.

diagnostic_matrix.symptom: High download clicks, high immediate exits on hardware table
diagnostic_matrix.investigation: Evaluate if ad attracted users expecting cloud execution who lack 4-5GB VRAM for 7B models.

failure_taxonomy_logging.logging_requirement: Any terminated variant must log empirical observation, sample size, failure category, and disproven hypothesis to prevent institutional re-testing.

output.confidence_rationale: Measurement architecture, event taxonomy, statistical experiment designs (PEXP-001..003), and diagnostic routing are strictly grounded in known product technical facts (CLI/daemon on port 11434, VRAM constraints, OS support) while explicitly withholding unmeasured telemetry and unconfigured budgets in accordance with PLANNING_ONLY governance.
unknown_facts: Baseline Click-Through Rates and Conversion Rates for developer ad variants are TO_BE_ESTABLISHED.
Exact authorized test flight budget and monetary stop-loss ceilings are NOT_CONFIGURED.
assumptions: Developers primarily evaluate local LLM tools based on terminal setup speed, API compatibility (localhost:11434), and VRAM footprint.
Outbound binary downloads and CLI curl command copies serve as the best non-telemetry proxies for user acquisition intent.
hypotheses: Terminal setup speed hooks (VAR-A) generate higher developer Link CTR than generic AI feature announcements.
Localhost REST API integration hooks (VAR-B) yield higher documentation engagement depth among engineering builders.
Upfront VRAM requirement transparency (VAR-C) filters out underpowered machines and increases qualified installation intent.
output.next_action: Submit Grounded Performance Package to CMO for budget configuration approval and coordinate with Creative/Strategist for flight asset staging.
